name: The Shorekeeper

tierList.prydwen: T0 Tower of Adversity, T0.5 Whimpering Wastes - the other premier generalist Support

kit.intro: 5-star Spectro Rectifier generalist Support, buffs are CRIT-based rather than ATK%-based. Resonance Liberation (175 Energy cost) summons a 30s 'Stellarealm' that upgrades through 3 tiers as teammates cast Intro Skills inside it: Outer (team HoT) -> Inner (up to 12.5% CRIT Rate, scaling with her Energy Regen) -> Supernal (up to 25% CRIT DMG, scaling with ER). Needs ~230-250% Energy Regen to hit the caps.

skills.normalAttack: Origin Calculus - 4-hit chain, each hit generates a Collapsed Core (-> homing Flare Star Butterfly after 6s).
skills.resonanceSkill: Chaos Theory - team heal + summons 5 Dim Star Butterflies, 20 Concerto on cast, 16s cooldown.
skills.forte: Astral Chord - Collapsed Cores/Empirical Data (5 each) resources; at 5 Empirical Data, enhanced Heavy Attack 'Illation' (preferred, has pull) or Mid-air 'Transmutation' instantly converts all Cores to Butterflies.
skills.liberation: End Loop - summons the Stellarealm (see intro).
skills.intro: Proof of Existence - Enlightenment (standard) / Discernment (empowered, once per Stellarealm, HP-scaling guaranteed-crit nuke, ends the Stellarealm early but doubles Concerto gain).
skills.outro: Binary Butterfly - 15% team DMG Amplify for 30s (persists through swaps) + up to 5 free interrupt-recoveries (auto perfect-dodge) for the active character.

bestWeapons: Call of the Abyss (85.1%, more healing-focused F2P)
echoSet: Rejuvenating Glow (best, Fallacy of No Return)

mainStats.cost3: Energy Regen (both 3-cost); Energy Regen / Spectro DMG

teams.name: Generalist Support (any team)
teams.notes: No particular required synergy - the most widely usable, effective third-slot support in the game (Augusta, Carlotta, Zani, Camellya teams all use her).

rotation: Opener (no Intro available): Basic P1-4 -> Forte Heavy (Illation) -> Basic P1-4 -> Forte Heavy (Illation) -> Skill -> Echo -> Liberation -> Outro. Standard (with Intro): Intro (Discernment) -> Basic P1-4 -> Forte Heavy (Illation) -> Skill -> Echo -> Liberation -> Outro.
communityNotes: Prydwen: top-tier (T0) generalist Support, providing uniquely strong CRIT Rate/CRIT DMG buffs plus persistent team DMG Amplify and strong healing; heavily wants a Concerto-generating weapon (Variation or her signature) or her opener/rotation feels notably slower, and lacks Verina's Coordinated Attack synergy for characters like Jinhsi. Considered essentially co-best generalist support alongside Verina, trading Verina's speed for stronger buffs.
